scope: Selector adjudication for the complete 69-field UA p.28 proposal cohort. This report records pre-note selectors and corrected roles/targets; it does not claim new numeric verification.

notePolicy.description: The note is the first/primary selector; the owner row is listed after it as contextual evidence. Focus covers only the Armor Class adjustment paragraph, excluding the separate rate-of-fire/range-label paragraph.
